rationale: Task T13 requires a CFO brief synthesizing key findings from T11 (portfolio deep-dive) and T12 (wider-net high-cost model), both specified as the only permitted sources. All numeric statements are cited per past feedback on executive briefs. Synthetic_caveats section is required based on feedback patterns from T8. Caveats are chosen to reflect statistical discipline: synthetic_data and sample_preview establish data provenance; model_limitations and no_operational_use address model constraints; association_not_causation states the proper framing for correlational findings. Brief causal language is set to 'allow' since the task calls for model results and performance discussion.
